results.title: Nested Ring Switchboard
results.prompt: Draw a complex artificial undirected graph called a nested ring switchboard. Create an outer 8-cycle O0-O1-O2-O3-O4-O5-O6-O7-O0 and an inner 8-cycle I0-I1-I2-I3-I4-I5-I6-I7-I0. Add spokes Oi-Ii for every i. Add shifted inner-to-outer chords I0-O3, I1-O4, I2-O5, I3-O6, I4-O7, I5-O0, I6-O1, I7-O2. Add four controller nodes C0,C1,C2,C3 placed as a small central diamond with cycle C0-C1-C2-C3-C0. Connect C0 to I0 and I4, C1 to I1 and I5, C2 to I2 and I6, and C3 to I3 and I7. Add two port nodes P and Q connected to O0,O1 and O4,O5 respectively. Make the nested structure symmetric, readable, and not overly spread out.

issues: Several central controller edges crowd non-incident controller nodes: the C0-I4 segment passes very close to C3, and the C0-I0/C2-I2 routing visually crowds C1 and C2.
The routed shifted inner-to-outer chords create multiple long polygonal detours around the rings, producing avoidable tangles and long edge paths.
On the right side, several unrelated edges between O1, O0, I0, I1, and I7 run close together for visible stretches, reducing readability.
The repeated 8-fold ring structure is only partially symmetric; some inner nodes and chord routes are uneven, making the nested ring less visually regular than it could be.
suggestions: Increase clearance around the central diamond by moving C0,C1,C2,C3 slightly farther apart or routing controller-to-inner edges outward around the diamond instead of through it.
Reroute C0-I4 and C0-I0 so they leave C0 at clearer angles and avoid passing close to C3 and C1.
Make the outer and inner 8-cycles more evenly circular or octagonal, with Oi and Ii aligned radially.
Use consistent short-bend routes for the shifted chords I0-O3 through I7-O2, keeping them in separate radial lanes rather than long nested detours.
Separate the dense right-side bundle near O1/O0/I0/I1/I7, especially edges involving I6-O1, I7-O2, and the O1/O0 spokes.
